claims.content: Configure scheduled operations for normal operational mode including opening and closing sequences for South Bound and North Bound directions at specified times.

goal.raw_text: Configure scheduled operations for normal operational mode including opening and closing sequences for South Bound and North Bound directions at specified times.

claims.content: System Administrator
The System Administrator must be assigned a security level and password.
User security levels shall be assigned at the command level, device, mode, workstation, and system function.
Each Agency may be referenced in one or more System Operation Schedules.
The System Administrator initiates the configuration of a System Operation Command Schedule.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the configuration of a System Operation Command Schedule.

claims.content: The System Administrator accesses the System Operation Command Schedule interface to configure or modify scheduled operations.
The system displays the current System Operation Command Schedule, allowing the administrator to view existing entries and their associated Device Commands.
The System Administrator selects a Device Command to associate with the schedule; each Device Command refers to one Device and may be referenced in one or more Device Command Steps.
The system validates that the selected Device Command is described by one Command Level and references valid Personnel Security Level Devices if required.
The System Administrator specifies the timing parameters for the schedule entry (e.g., start time, end time, recurrence).
The system logs the creation or modification of the System Operation Command Schedule entry in the System Operation Schedule log.
The system updates the display to reflect the new or modified schedule entry and confirms successful configuration to the System Administrator.
If the System Administrator attempts to modify a schedule entry without proper authentication, the system shall require an additional login password for that option.
If conflicting or redundant entries are detected during database modification, the GUI shall analyze the data before storing and notify the System Administrator.
If the System Administrator wishes to change user accounts remotely, the configuration option shall allow user accounts to be changed remotely in the field units.

If the System Administrator modifies database tables and conflicting or redundant entries are detected, the GUI shall analyze the data before storing in the database and notify the system administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries.
If the option to configure device rules is selected during schedule configuration, it shall require an additional login password for that option.
The System Operation Command Schedule entry is successfully created or modified and stored in the database.
The creation or modification of the System Operation Command Schedule entry is recorded in the System Operation Command Log.
If any conflicting or redundant entries were detected during the configuration, the System Administrator has been notified by the GUI.
